name: @ayni.org/ayni-ui-core
description: Framework-independent core of the Ayni UI (UI-SHELL-004): agents and controllers, trust resolution, sessions and binding, the conversation reducer, spaces, memories and deletion within a window (profile 3.3), the tools of a space, the confirmation of a tool call and the sources of replies (profile 3.4), each person's own accounts and the Connect card (profile 3.5), the Notifications of a space and of the agent, where an approver finds an approval once (agent D114), a space's governance: one owner or none, the successor, the stewards, the approval timeouts and the approval policy of a tool with its progress and notices (profile 3.5.4, agent D135 to D142), admin access from the agent's card: Show Admin, the ADMIN area while the grant is open, Audit and Operations with a reason for each read and action, a person found by name (profile 3.5.5, agent D132 to D134), the agent's menu in one order and with one wording for both clients, a space's tools by feature, each with one provider chosen and changed, the location of a feature and its choices (profile 3.5.8, agent D120 to D124), a team space's managed folder: the modes of Files, the folder's state, a member's access and its notices (profile 3.5.9, agent D145 to D150), an account that several sources use, each source allowed, allowed in part or not allowed, with Allow and Allow more (profile 3.5.10, agent D118), the local store and sync; shared by the browser UI and the Ayni app
